title: 3D to 2D Knight Vs Orc experimenting isometric fighter
author: Dakroh_88
selftext:
Alright took a stab at it for fun. Was interested in figuring out how to make sprites with AI.. This little project cost me about $2.50 to make all the models. And like 19% my weekly sub, Opus5.5. Used blender, godot and some of my homebrew tools. 

So since it seems like AI cant make sprite sheets accurately just by generating them. I decided since we have the ability to make models, and with the blender mcp it can rig and animate them.. why not just render out sprites from the animations.. This whole thing probably took like 4hours to make.

comments.author: Dakroh_88
comments.body: Sprites that were made for this can be seen here if anyone cares to see them [https://www.keyframe.it.com/sprite-puppeteer](https://www.keyframe.it.com/sprite-puppeteer)

replies.author: mccoypauley
replies.body: Wild! I want to make an isometric grid-based FFTactics clone, but with Western sprites like this. Would you be able to share a rundown of your process and what those homebrew tools were?
